description: This Java class implements an in-memory device connection service, specifically managing last known gateways for devices within tenants. It provides methods to set and retrieve the last known gateway information for devices, with configuration for maximum devices per tenant, and uses in-memory data structures like HashMap and ConcurrentHashMap. The class is annotated as a Spring @Repository and uses Vert.x's AbstractVerticle.

classes.name: MapBasedDeviceConnectionService
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of DeviceConnectionService that manages last known gateways for devices across tenants, with configuration for maximum devices per tenant, integrating with Vert.x and Spring frameworks.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last known gateway for a specified device within a tenant, respecting the maximum number of devices per tenant configured. Executes asynchronously and reports success or failure.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway information for a specified device within a tenant, providing the result asynchronously.

methods.name: createLastKnownGatewayJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON representation for last known gateway information, initializing the gateway ID and last update time.

methods.name: setLastUpdateDate
methods.description: Updates the JSON object with the current timestamp indicating the last update time.
